Landmark readout — first Ph3 data in the TL1A class. Ph2 ARTEMIS-UC: 26.5% remission vs 1.5% placebo (composite estimand, Wk12). Companion Dx (TNFSF15 haplotype) in co-development. Every TL1A program will be benchmarked against this result.

CD extension of tulisokibart. If ATLAS-UC succeeds, ARES-CD converts a UC-only asset into a full IBD franchise — substantially expanding commercial peak sales potential and deal value for any partnered asset.

Ph3 proceeding despite TUSCANY-2 Ph2b primary endpoint MISS (24% remission vs 12% placebo, p=NS at Wk14). Roche justified on secondary endpoints + 43% OLE remission in biomarker+ patients. Acquired via Telavant ~$7.1B (Oct 2023). Highest-stakes go/no-go in the class.

CD companion to AMETRINE. Carries elevated risk given the Ph2b UC primary endpoint failure. Ph3 CD design was locked before full TUSCANY-2 data — Roche committed to a two-indication Ph3 strategy regardless. Success would still represent major commercial value.

Strongest Ph2 efficacy in class: RELIEVE-UC 48% remission at 900mg Wk14 vs 20% placebo; RELIEVE-CD 48% endoscopic response (composite estimand, both). Ph3 STARSCAPE (UC) + SUNSCAPE (CD) both enrolling. If Ph3 confirms, duvakitug becomes the dominant commercial TL1A asset.

SPY001 is Spyre's extended half-life anti-TL1A monoAb. Ph2 UC readout Q2 2026. Critical: establishes the TL1A mono component used in SPY072 (TL1A+IL-23 bispecific SKYWAY) — Spyre's strategy validates each target alone before combining.

First TL1A data in rheumatology (RA, PsA, axSpA) — three sub-studies reporting Q4 2026. Positive results would establish TL1A as a multi-indication inflammatory target beyond IBD, materially expanding deal value for all TL1A bispecifics and validating the broader mechanism.

Extended half-life >71 days supports Q8W or less frequent dosing — key differentiation vs. monthly biologics. Ph2b UC topline year-end 2026. Xencor runs dual track: XmAb942 mono (Ph2b) + XmAb412 TL1A×IL-23 bispecific (pre-Ph1). Success here de-risks the bispecific TL1A arm.

COMPLETED — Presented DDW May 2026. Key result: t½ >71 days confirmed in healthy volunteers, enabling Q8W+ dosing. Clean safety/tolerability profile. Data de-risked the platform and directly supported XENITH-UC Ph2b progression and XmAb412 bispecific advancement.

First-in-class FcRn-recycling TL1A×IL-23p19 bispecific in Ph1 SAD/MAD. Q1 2027 readout (10+ events). Will be the first human PK/safety data for any TL1A×IL-23p19 bispecific — a field-defining signal for the bispecific development thesis.

Ongoing Ph1. CLD-423 (QX030N) licensed from Qyuns to Caldera ($10M + ~25% equity, up to $545M). First Chinese TL1A×IL-23 bispecific in clinical stage. Ph2 design/timing not disclosed. Clean Ph1 data would unlock significant milestone payments and de-risk follow-on partnering.

COMPLETED — Preclinical poster DDW May 2026. Xtend™ FcXtend platform applied to TL1A×IL-23p19 bispecific targeting t½ >71 days. FIH H2 2026. Xencor's dual-track strategy: XmAb942 mono validates TL1A; XmAb412 bispecific adds IL-23 arm from a de-risked base.

Highest-value preclinical deal in space: $125M upfront / $1.845B total (Earendil→Sanofi, Apr 2025). AI-designed tetravalent (2+2) format — engineered avidity advantage over standard IgG bispecifics. IND filing expected 2026; FIH timing not disclosed. Sanofi's entry into the bispecific TL1A class.

Enrollment completed May 2025. Tests guselkumab (IL-23p19) + golimumab (TNF) combination in UC. H1 2026 readout pending. Strategic read: if dual blockade clearly outperforms mono, it validates the combination hypothesis — and strengthens the case for TL1A×IL-23 bispecifics in a single molecule.

AbbVie testing risankizumab (IL-23p19/Skyrizi) + trosunilimab (anti-TL1A) combination in CD. H2 2026 readout. This is the most direct clinical validation of the TL1A+IL-23 dual-target hypothesis. Positive data would be the strongest possible endorsement for the bispecific strategy.
